description: Let the webview subscribe to the live-session broadcast. The session's Tauri transport is an event emitted from Rust (see lib.rs's forwarder task); without core:event:allow-listen the webview's listen() is denied by the ACL and the desktop window silently never follows an agent's or another window's edits. This is deliberately the only capability granted: app commands need none, and nothing else here uses a core plugin.
